_meta.title: Ethnic Power Relations 2021: simplified settlement areas joined to group status
_meta.notice: Derived from GeoEPR 2021 and EPR Core 2021. The polygons have been simplified (about 3 km) and are not the original GeoEPR geometries.
citation: Vogt, Manuel, Nils-Christian Bormann, Seraina Ruegger, Lars-Erik Cederman, Philipp Hunziker, and Luc Girardin. 2015. Integrating Data on Ethnicity, Geography, and Conflict: The Ethnic Power Relations Dataset Family. Journal of Conflict Resolution 59(7): 1327-1342.

Wucherpfennig, Julian, Nils B. Weidmann, Luc Girardin, Lars-Erik Cederman, and Andreas Wimmer. 2011. Politically Relevant Ethnic Groups across Space and Time: Introducing the GeoEPR Dataset. Conflict Management and Peace Science 28(5): 423-437.
_meta.consent: Hosted with the written consent of ETH Zurich (Luc Girardin), given November 2026, on these conditions.
_meta.changes: Polygons simplified (shapely, tolerance 0.03 degrees, about 3 km) and rounded to 4 decimals; status periods from EPR Core 2021 added to each polygon. Groups with no polygon are drawn at an evenly spread spot in their country, which means nothing.
